Lock Upp 2 Winner to Donate Prize Money to Shilpa Shinde's Shelter

Shreya Kalra, the winner of the reality show Lock Upp 2, has announced her intention to donate a portion of her prize money to a shelter home run by actress Shilpa Shinde. Shinde, a former Bigg Boss winner, participated in Lock Upp 2 but was reportedly overshadowed by Kalra. The exact amount of prize money and the portion to be donated have not been specified.
